description: Kit for Junction, an AI ad agent that dispatches one brief to 32 ad platforms like a transit network: dashboard icons, a 3D signal hero, feature cards, a route-map launch banner, a milestone departure-board story, a channel intro and an animated interchange scene. Now with the full dashboard icon set, a brief-ticket hero, Audience Scout / Brand Guard / Connectors cards, an arrivals-board case-study banner, a station-sign lower third, a new-line launch video and a brief-press process scene.
idea: Your AI agent runs ads across 30+ ad platforms
